english.note: Use this all-purpose rendering when someone performs, works, or handles something brilliantly.

examples.english: We handled the customer's complaint brilliantly, and they even wrote to praise us.
examples.traditional: 我哋好出色咁處理咗個客嘅投訴，佢仲特登寫信讚我哋。
